args.body: Prioritize finishing CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL under its valid lease. Reuse a completed equivalent result if present. If the bilingual delivery sample commits, read it and add the actual delivery entry point's observed result on the same fixtures, or record the concrete input incompatibility. Read back and close with a lesson. Use the sample only as a companion to the existing exact draft and operator decision. Preserve the pending decision and keep the sample unsent.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows no new interpreted requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Reconsider it when a readable first-party field specification establishes the requirement.
